About the salon

A neighborhood nail salon on Sharlands

La Belle Nails is a nail salon in Northwest Reno, on Sharlands Avenue. Come in for a manicure, gel nails, a pedicure or nail art.

Clients have given the salon 4.4 stars across 212 Google reviews. To see recent work, visit the salon on Instagram.
